text_en: Again he entered the synagogue, and a man was there who had a withered hand.
text_cn: 耶稣又进了会堂，在那里有一个人，他的一只手枯干了。

text_en: They watched him to see whether he would cure him on the sabbath, so that they might accuse him.
text_cn: 他们窥察耶稣是否在安息日治好那人，好去控告他。

text_en: And he said to the man who had the withered hand, “Come forward. ”
text_cn: 耶稣对那有一只手枯了的人说：“起来，站在中间！”

text_en: Then he said to them, “Is it lawful to do good or to do harm on the sabbath, to save life or to kill? ” But they were silent.
text_cn: 遂对他们说：“安息日许行善呢，或作恶呢？许救命呢，或害命呢？”他们一声不响。

text_en: He looked around at them with anger; he was grieved at their hardness of heart and said to the man, “Stretch out your hand. ” He stretched it out, and his hand was restored.
text_cn: 耶稣遂含怒环视他们，见他们的心硬而悲伤，就对那人说：“伸出手来！”他一伸，他的手就复了原。

text_en: The Pharisees went out and immediately conspired with the Herodians against him, how to destroy him.
text_cn: 法利塞人一出去，立刻便与黑落德党人作陷害耶稣的商讨，为除灭他。

text_en: Jesus departed with his disciples to the sea, and a great multitude from Galilee followed him;
text_cn: 那时，耶稣同自己的门徒退到海边去，有许多民众从加里肋亚跟随了来，并有从犹太、

text_en: hearing all that he was doing, they came to him in great numbers from Judea, Jerusalem, Idumea, beyond the Jordan, and the region around Tyre and Sidon.
text_cn: 耶路撒冷、依杜默雅、约但河彼岸、提洛和漆冬一带地方的许多群众，听说他所作的一切事，都来到他跟前。

text_en: He told his disciples to have a boat ready for him because of the crowd, so that they would not crush him;
text_cn: 因为人多，他遂吩咐他的门徒，为自己备好一只小船，免得人拥挤他。

text_en: for he had cured many, so that all who had diseases pressed upon him to touch him.
text_cn: 因为他治好了许多人，所以，凡有病灾的人都向他涌来，要触摸他。

text_en: Whenever the unclean spirits saw him, they fell down before him and shouted, “You are the Son of God! ”
text_cn: 邪魔一见了他，就俯伏在他面前，喊说：“你是天主子。”

text_en: But he sternly ordered them not to make him known.
text_cn: 他却严厉责斥他们，不要把他显露出来。

text_en: He went up the mountain and called to him those whom he wanted, and they came to him.
text_cn: 随后，耶稣上了山，把自己所想要的人召来，他们便来到他面前。

text_en: And he appointed twelve, whom he also named apostles, to be with him, and to be sent out to proclaim the message,
text_cn: 他就选定了十二人，为同他常在一起，并为派遣他们去宣讲，

text_en: and to have authority to cast out demons.
text_cn: 且具有驱魔的权柄。

text_en: So he appointed the twelve: Simon (to whom he gave the name Peter);
text_cn: 他选定了这十二人：西满，给他起名叫伯多禄，

text_en: James son of Zebedee and John the brother of James (to whom he gave the name Boanerges, that is, Sons of Thunder);
text_cn: 载伯德的儿子雅各伯和雅各伯的弟弟若望，并为他们起名叫“波纳尔革”，就是“雷霆之子”，

text_en: and Andrew, and Philip, and Bartholomew, and Matthew, and Thomas, and James son of Alphaeus, and Thaddaeus, and Simon the Cananaean,
text_cn: 安德肋、斐理伯、巴尔多禄茂、玛窦、多默、阿耳斐的儿子雅各伯，达陡和热诚者西满，

text_en: and Judas Iscariot, who betrayed him. Then he went home;
text_cn: 并犹达斯依斯加略，他是负卖耶稣者。

text_en: and the crowd came together again, so that they could not even eat.
text_cn: 耶稣到了家，群众又聚集了来，以致他们连饭都不能吃。

text_en: When his family heard it, they went out to restrain him, for people were saying, “He has gone out of his mind. ”
text_cn: 他的人听说了，便出来要抓住他，因为他们说：“他疯了！”

text_en: And the scribes who came down from Jerusalem said, “He has Beelzebul, and by the ruler of the demons he casts out demons. ”
text_cn: 从耶路撒冷下来的经师们说：“他附有贝耳则步。”又说：“他赖魔王驱魔。”

text_en: And he called them to him, and spoke to them in parables, “How can Satan cast out Satan?
text_cn: 耶稣遂把他们叫来，用比喻向他们说：“撒殚怎能驱逐撒殚呢？

text_en: If a kingdom is divided against itself, that kingdom cannot stand.
text_cn: 一国若自相纷争，那国就不能存立；

text_en: And if a house is divided against itself, that house will not be able to stand.
text_cn: 一家若自相纷争，那家也将不能存立。

text_en: And if Satan has risen up against himself and is divided, he cannot stand, but his end has come.
text_cn: 撒殚若起来自相攻击纷争，也就不能存立，必要灭亡。

text_en: But no one can enter a strong man’s house and plunder his property without first tying up the strong man; then indeed the house can be plundered.
text_cn: 决没有人能进入壮士的家，抢劫他的家具的，除非先把那壮士捆起来，然后抢劫他的家。

text_en: “Truly I tell you, people will be forgiven for their sins and whatever blasphemies they utter;
text_cn: 我实在告诉你们：世人的一切罪恶，连所说的任何亵渎的话，都可得赦免；

text_en: but whoever blasphemes against the Holy Spirit can never have forgiveness, but is guilty of an eternal sin”—
text_cn: 但谁若亵渎了圣神，永远不得赦免，而是永久罪恶的犯人。”

text_en: for they had said, “He has an unclean spirit. ”
text_cn: 耶稣说这话，是因为他们说“他附有邪魔。”

text_en: Then his mother and his brothers came; and standing outside, they sent to him and called him.
text_cn: 耶稣的母亲和他的兄弟们来了，站在外边，派人到他跟前去叫他。

text_en: A crowd was sitting around him; and they said to him, “Your mother and your brothers and sisters are outside, asking for you. ”
text_cn: 那时，群众正围着他坐着，有人给他说：“看，你的母亲和你的兄弟在外边找你。”

text_en: And he replied, “Who are my mother and my brothers? ”
text_cn: 耶稣回答他们说：“谁是我的母亲和我的兄弟？”

text_en: And looking at those who sat around him, he said, “Here are my mother and my brothers!
text_cn: 遂环视他周围坐着的人说：“看，我的母亲和我的兄弟！

text_en: Whoever does the will of God is my brother and sister and mother. ”
text_cn: 因为谁奉行天主的旨意，他就是我的兄弟、姊妹和母亲。”
